news.title: KLETC's 362nd Basic Training Class graduates on 25th anniversary of 9/11
news.summary_en: Seventeen officers graduated from the Kansas Law Enforcement Training Center on Sept. 11. Members of the 362nd Basic Training Class will go on to serve in communities throughout the state.

news.title: Law Review Symposium to discuss voting rights
news.summary_en: On Oct. 9, the Kansas Law Review’s 2026 Symposium will bring together leading academics and practitioners to explore the impact of the recent Louisiana v. Callais decision on voting rights legislation and litigation across the country.

news.title: KU to host series of informational meetings for students with intellectual disabilities, parents and educators
news.summary_en: The University of Kansas Transition to Postsecondary Education program (KU TPE) is hosting a series of informational meetings in several Kansas cities in October and November. KU TPE is a two-year, fully inclusive undergraduate certificate program at the Lawrence campus.

news.title: KU Extended Learning relaunches in-person Lean Six Sigma Black Belt course
news.summary_en: KU will offer its Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification course at the KU Edwards Campus in Overland Park on Oct. 5, 19 and Nov. 2. Instructor Heather McCain will offer a free one-hour webinar Sept. 23 to cover course concepts.

news.title: University of Kansas Debate program named best in nation
news.summary_en: The University of Kansas Debate program was identified as the No. 1 debate program in the country in a 2026 ranking of the “Top 50 Competitive College Debate Programs in the U.S.” from American Liberty Media.

news.title: Audio-Reader’s Audio Sale returns to Lawrence Public Library for 3-day event
news.summary_en: Audio-Reader’s Audio Sale will take place Sept. 11-13, offering bargains on more than 100 pieces of vintage and modern audio equipment as well as over 1,000 vinyl records, along with cassette tapes, musical instruments, CDs and other unique audio finds.

news.title: KU sociologist Mehrangiz Najafizadeh earns rare third Fulbright U.S. Scholar Award
news.summary_en: Mehrangiz Najafizadeh, associate professor of sociology at KU, has earned her third Fulbright U.S. Scholar Award. She will teach and conduct research in Azerbaijan during the spring 2027 semester, offering courses and interdisciplinary seminars while continuing her sociological research. news.title: New book ‘Leading Without Apology’ provides guidance to women to advance to educational leadership roles
news.summary_en: Women make up a majority of teachers and education professionals, but they are underrepresented in school leadership roles. A new book by KU scholars aims to help women anticipate the challenges to advancing and advocate for themselves to take on such roles.

news.title: Military aircraft to fly over Lawrence campus Thursday, Friday in advance of KU-Missouri football game
news.summary_en: Military jets will fly over the University of Kansas campus Thursday, Sept. 10, and Friday, Sept. 11, in advance of Friday's KU football game versus the University of Missouri.

news.title: KU Law to host environmental law scholar James Salzman for lecture on drinking water
news.summary_en: The University of Kansas School of Law will host environmental law scholar James Salzman for a public lecture Sept. 14. “The Past, Present, and Future of Drinking Water” will take place from 4:30 to 6 p.m. in 106 Green Hall at the University of Kansas School of Law.

news.title: Indigenous Arts Initiative will offer workshops on art, filmmaking
news.summary_en: The Indigenous Arts Initiative, which includes partners from the University of Kansas, will bring two distinguished Indigenous artists and educators to Lawrence this September for a series of free public workshops exploring art, culture, storytelling and filmmaking.
